name: geethanjalee-monorepo
description: Geethanjalee Live in Concert 2026 — React (Vite) Frontend & NestJS Backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
